predictions.source_summary: Email content comes from template files (email.template, email.invite_template) with substitutions from user input (email addresses, tokens, room names, sender info) and system-generated values (message IDs, timestamps). Email addresses and substitution data come from HTTP requests and validation sessions.
predictions.sink_summary: SMTP server via smtplib.sendmail() with UTF-8 encoded email content
predictions.guard_summary: Email address parsing validation (lines 57-61), template file reading, and UTF-8 encoding. No content sanitization or injection protection for email headers/body.
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled and system-generated data flows into email templates via string formatting, then gets sent via SMTP with UTF-8 encoding but without proper email header/content sanitization against injection attacks.
predictions.context_summary: Function sends email using templates with substitutions. The changed line adds UTF-8 encoding to ensure proper character handling when sending email content through SMTP.
